name: gmail
description: Gmail workflows for semantic mail search, metadata-first reading, full-read approvals, organization, drafts, and reviewed sending.

interface.shortDescription: Search, read, organize, draft, and send Gmail work with confirmation safeguards.
interface.longDescription: Gmail gives Gilbert Codex an organized plugin surface for email workflows with up to six connected accounts, metadata-first reads, approval-gated full message access, local semantic ranking, batch label changes, separate-recipient sends, and reviewed destructive actions.
defaultPrompt: Summarize important unread Gmail threads from today.
Draft a reply to this Gmail thread and let me review it before sending.
Find Gmail messages that need follow-up and group them by priority.
